_meta.description: Phase 2 (s175, 2026-05-12) - bruiser archetype weights for ds.hybrid scorer. α weights DPS, β weights EHP. Per-champion overrides keyed by DDragon champion id (NOT display name - display→id resolution happens server-side in _resolve_champion_id). Fallback to default for any champion not listed.
_meta.default_rationale: α=β=0.50 means equal-weight balanced fighter. Bumping α makes the scorer prefer offensive items; bumping β makes it prefer defensive items. Sum doesn't have to equal 1.0 but the recommended convention is α+β=1.0 so operators can think of (0.65, 0.35) as '65/35 toward DPS'.
